Details zum Jobangebot
Speak our language!
We are Lingoda. Our mission is to build bridges around the world through
language learning.
Lingoda is a fast-growing online language partner for language learners aspiring
to provide a human-centric, personalised and seamless learning experience
unmatched by competitors. With Lingoda, you're not just learning - you're
teaming up with an expert who understands your goals and guides you to
success, every step of the way.
Our classes are teacher-led, and supported in- and out-of-class by the latest
technologies and a unique curriculum to empower our students to achieve their
language goals. High-quality classes are available online 24/7, so anyone
anywhere has the opportunity to learn a language with Lingoda.
As a company we bring out the best in people with a positive culture. We
challenge ourselves, and we challenge others. We work smart and make it
happen. We believe in personal growth and inclusion.
We work hard to contribute to a better society. How? Here are three examples:
• Lingodaʼs MATCH network and Global Career Centre seek to upskill and match
migrants to career opportunities in Germany, supporting them through
government-funded education programs
• In the German healthcare sector, we support international nurses, doctors and
midwives to obtain language and professional recognition through state-
sponsored education programs. As a result we have become one of the largest
educational providers in this field in Germany
• In December 2022 at the Digital Education Awards, we won “Best Digital
Learning Product of the Year” and in 2024, Lingoda was included in The Time's
list of the 100 best EdTech companies
The Web Team is part of the Creative & Marketing Operations Team, the in-house
agency of Lingoda, developing and executing creative concepts and assets for all
communication topics. The range of projects varies in scale and type e.g. 360
digital campaigns. The team works across all Lingoda markets.
We are currently looking for aSenior Website Manager (all genders)based in
Berlin or working remotely.
Your mission with us:
As a Senior Website Manager at Lingoda, you will be a key leader for the
globallingoda.comwebsite, driving higher visitor engagement and conversions to
help us achieve our goals of attracting more students to try our products and
services.
You will oversee the management and optimization of our WordPress-based CMS.

role demands a blend of CMS expertise, strategic insight, and hands-on tech
leadership to ensure our website is helping to drive our growth.
Your tasks:
Deliver Key Projects:Deliver a diverse range of web projects to improve
the quality, user experience, technical implementation and security of our
marketing website
CMS Management: Lead the administration and maintenance of our
WordPress CMS, ensuring itʼs secure, up-to-date, and optimised for
performance
Content Deployment:Collaborate with the content team to streamline
workflows for content publishing, updates, and management across the
site
Customization and Development:Work hands-on and with our external
development team to implement new features, customizations, and
integrations that enhance user experience and site functionality.
Examples include small web components, full web pages, and multi-page
funnel flows with user state
Coordinate with External Development Team:Maintain effective
communication with external developers and manage their workload from
brief to final delivery, ensuring efficiency and quality of execution
A/B Testing:Collaborate with our CRO Manager to build, launch and
manage server-side A/B tests
SEO and Performance Optimization:Ensure the website is optimised for
search engines and continuously improve load times, mobile
responsiveness, and overall performance
Analytics and Reporting:Track and analyse site performance metrics,
generating insights to inform ongoing improvements and strategic
decisions
Team Mentoring:Provide guidance and mentorship to junior team
members and manage relationships with external developers and
agencies
You bring to Lingoda:
Minimum 5 years of experience working with WordPress, including
custom themes and its entire environment
A proven track record of success with a high-growth B2C company with
10,000ʼs unique visitors per month
Good understanding of A/B testing
Good understanding of localisation of global websites
You have experience with HTML, CSS, PHP, JavaScript and TypeScript
Good knowledge of GA4 and GTM
You are well versed in technical SEO website implementations and best
practices
Good understanding of page load performance and caching techniques
Experience working with project management tools such as Jira and
Asana
Nice to have - CloudFront, Github
You add to our culture with:
You are a problem solver and donʼt wait to be given all the answers
You are proactive and take ownership of your projects and your own
development
You are structured and have the ability to manage multiple ongoing
projects while well managing your own time
You are an excellent communicator
You are not afraid of complexity and problem-solving
You love working in an international environment, also together with
Creatives
You are open to feedback to consistently improve quality and skill set
What you can expect from Lingoda:
Approachable leaders and transparent communication - every voice
counts at Lingoda!
Company events and colleagues who are always happy to socialise +
budgets towards team building events!
An inclusive environment with great team spirit and passion for languages
A well-structured and exciting onboarding process to set you up for
success!
The possibility to work remotely from your home or in the office located in
the heart of Berlin
Education funds because we want to see our people grow
Free accessto our language classes
Mental Health programs
Corporate benefits & pension funds
28 vacation days per year
Free snacks & drinks at the office
The modern hardware necessary for your work (n/a for freelancers)
Flexible working hours

Lingoda is dedicated to promoting diversity and inclusion in the workplace. As an
equal opportunities and affirmative action employer, we strive to create a
workforce that reflects the diversity of our user base. Our commitment ensures
that every applicant is assessed on the basis of their skills and qualifications,
regardless of age, gender identity, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability, or
religion.
We ask that you please apply directly via the link provided in the job description
or directly on our website. Due to GDPR regulations, applications sent otherwise
will not be considered.
Please note that if you are based outside of Germany that only a freelance
contract can be offered. All our contracts whether freelance or regular German
employment contract start on a 2 year time period.
